label: Trickplay Sheets
description: Generate the seek-preview thumbnails video players use while scrubbing: sprite sheets at a fixed interval with a WebVTT storyboard and a Jellyfin/DASH-compatible JSON manifest. Batch a folder for one sheet set per video.

sourceIds.label: Source(s)
sourceIds.description: Video(s) to index — pick a folder, one or more files, or drag-and-drop. One trickplay sheet set (sheets + WebVTT + manifest) per input.

tileWidth.label: Tile width (px)
tileWidth.description: Thumbnail width in pixels (height derives from the source aspect; both even-rounded).

rowsPerSheet.label: Rows per sheet
rowsPerSheet.description: Maximum thumbnail rows per sheet — longer content spills to additional sheets.

outputFormat.label: Output
outputFormat.description: Sheet output format. "png"/"jpeg" render static sheets with WebVTT + JSON manifest sidecars; "mp4" renders an animated contact-sheet preview (no sidecars).
